1654-  # Promote the draft into server_config + write the chosen admin_group_claim + set
1655-  # bootstrap_completed, then clear the draft. Mirrors Go saveBootstrapConfigTx +
1656-  # saveAdminGroupClaimTx + saveClaimMappingTx + clearDraftTx + completeBootstrapTx.
1657-  # The encrypted oidc_client_secret blob is carried forward unchanged (never decrypted).
1658-  #
1659-  # M1 (atomicity): when the real Repo is running the upserts run inside a single
1660-  # `Ecto.Adapters.SQL.transaction/2` so a mid-flight crash cannot leave a half-promoted
1661-  # config (e.g. bootstrap_completed = "true" but no admin_group_claim, which would brick
1662-  # the gate). The seam/no-Repo path (unit tests) has no transaction boundary and runs the
1663-  # same sequential upserts.
1664:  defp complete_bootstrap(draft, admin_group_claim, admin_group_claim_path) do
1665-    result =
1666-      if not seam_installed?() and running?(Nebu.Repo) do
1667-        # Ecto.Repo.transaction/1 (NOT Ecto.Adapters.SQL.transaction/2, which does not
1668-        # exist) — wrap the sequential upserts so a mid-flight crash cannot leave a
1669-        # half-promoted config. The inline Ecto.Adapters.SQL.query calls inside
1670-        # do_complete_bootstrap run on the transaction's checked-out connection.
1671-        case Nebu.Repo.transaction(fn ->
1672-               case do_complete_bootstrap(draft, admin_group_claim, admin_group_claim_path) do
1673-                 {:error, reason} ->
1674-                   # Roll back the transaction and surface the error to the caller.
1675-                   Nebu.Repo.rollback(reason)
1676-
1677-                 :ok ->
1678-                   :ok
1679-               end
1680-             end) do
1681-          {:ok, :ok} -> :ok
1682-          {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
1683-        end
1684-      else
1685-        do_complete_bootstrap(draft, admin_group_claim, admin_group_claim_path)
1686-      end

1688-    # Only trigger cache refresh when the bootstrap actually completed successfully.
1689-    # C-1 (oidc-env-optional-bootstrap cycle-1): after the config is written,
1690-    # refresh OidcConfig and JwksCache so the newly-written OIDC values (issuer,
1691-    # audience, jwks_uri) are immediately visible to OidcPlug on this node. Without
1692-    # this, OidcConfig's ETS cache retains nil values until the next TTL-based
1693-    # refresh, causing every Matrix Bearer token to be rejected with 401 until a
1694-    # process restart.
1695-    #
1696-    # Refresh OidcConfig first (makes issuer/audience/jwks_uri warm in ETS) and
1697-    # then JwksCache (reads the newly-warm jwks_uri to fetch signing keys).
1698-    # Errors in either call are non-fatal for bootstrap completion — they are
1699-    # already logged inside each module and the TTL-based refresh will recover.
1700-    #
1701-    # Test seam: `:bootstrap_cache_refresh_hook` (0-arity fun) is invoked instead
1702-    # when installed; this lets unit tests verify the C-1 refresh path without a
1703-    # live Repo or real OidcConfig/JwksCache GenServers. In production the seam is
1704-    # absent and the Process.whereis guards below run directly.
